name: Holistic Life Coaching
headline: Bring the way you live closer to what matters most.
summary: Integrate capacity into choices, boundaries, habits, relationships, priorities and action.
description: Whole-person coaching that helps you create clarity, make intentional choices, navigate change and turn insight into sustainable action. Whether you’re navigating a transition, feeling stuck or overextended, or working on boundaries and follow-through, coaching helps you bring the way you live closer to what matters most.
metaDescription: Holistic life coaching in Brighton and Howell, MI, or virtually, to bring more clarity, balance and practical next steps to the life you want.
scopeNote: Coaching does not replace licensed mental health, medical, legal, financial, or other professional care. When needs fall into those areas, we’ll encourage you to work with the right qualified professional.

value.heading: How we help
value.lead: Holistic life coaching at TAB starts by looking at the whole picture—not just the goal in front of you.
paragraphs: Work affects health. Stress affects relationships. Responsibilities affect routines. We help you step back and understand how those pieces interact.
Coaching is collaborative and practical. Accountability is part of the process, and it should feel supportive rather than punitive.

cards.title: Transitions and competing demands
cards.body: Find your footing when work, family and change all pull at once.

cards.title: Feeling stuck or stretched thin
cards.body: Step back, see what’s really in the way, and choose a next step.

cards.title: Boundaries and priorities
cards.body: Decide what matters most and protect time and energy for it.

cards.title: Habits and follow-through
cards.body: Supportive accountability for the changes you’ve chosen to make.

cards.title: Agency and alignment
cards.body: Make decisions that reflect your values, not just your obligations.

cards.title: Bringing it all together
cards.body: Connect body, work, relationships, recovery and goals into one picture.

value.transform: Change patterns and choices that limit agency.
value.balance: Bring time, energy, relationships, priorities and recovery into balance.
value.quote: Turn insight into agency and action.

steps.title: Clarify
steps.body: We start with what feels out of alignment and what you want to be different.

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: Together we build realistic steps that fit your responsibilities and energy.

steps.title: Adapt
steps.body: Progress isn’t linear. We adjust as circumstances and priorities change.

items.q: How is coaching different from therapy?
items.a: Coaching focuses on goals, priorities, habits, and practical next steps. Therapy addresses mental health treatment and is provided by licensed professionals. We’ll help you find the right support if you need it.
Yes. Coaching is available virtually and in person.
We agree on commitments together and check in regularly. Accountability is supportive, not punitive.
